rows.text: for each index below dword `+4` of `rcx` (unsigned), replaces the dword at `rcx+8` plus 4 times the index with `0020E620(0020E600(that dword) + the low 32 bits of rcx zero-extended)`; then, also when the count is zero, stores `rcx` in qword `02EC0B68`

clamps `edx` to 0 when negative and to 1 when above 1; returns without work when `ecx` is 2 or more (signed); otherwise, with the record at `022CAE90` plus `ecx` times `0x294`, stores `r8b` at byte `+6` plus `edx` of the record, calls `0035E810` and stores its dword result at `+0x1C` plus `edx` times 4

calls `00249580` with `rcx` unchanged (result r); when qword `+0xD0` of `rcx` is non-null calls `003697F0` on it; calls `00249210(r, 7, byte +0xC1 plus 0xE, 3)` with fifth (stack) argument 0 and then `00249410(r)`; ORs 8 into dword `+0xC4` and stores qword `+8` of the `00249210` result in qword `+0xD0`

notes: 0035B3E0: the added base is ebx moved to ebp (32-bit), so only the low half of rcx is added; OPUS may want to confirm against the bytes. 0035FED0: 0035E810 gets no explicit argument set-up, so none is stated. 00379F30: the entry is the zero-extension; the row is anchored on the tail jump.
